bucket: Duplicate remedy: refund AND replacement on the same order
cost_type: money that should not have left
rationale: Policy S5: 'In no case is a customer to receive both'. The target is zero; 90% allows for genuine exceptions escalated to Finance.
evidence: replacement_issued=Y, or the agent's own note states both were given

bucket: Pricing and coupon refunds: discount not applied at checkout
rationale: Each is a checkout defect refunded after the fact. Fixing coupon validation removes most; 70% leaves room for genuine price-drop goodwill.
evidence: ai_theme=pricing_coupon; customer text cites a coupon or advertised price

bucket: Goodwill above the Rs 500 cap (after restatement)
cost_type: money that should not have left
rationale: Policy S5 caps goodwill and requires Team Lead approval. 50% is deliberately cautious: some of these may have had approval that the export does not record.
evidence: ai_suggested_reason=GW-OTHER and amount > cap; only the excess is counted

bucket: Refund released without the unit being collected
cost_type: money out with no goods back
rationale: The refund is owed, but releasing it before pickup loses the unit as well. 60% reflects that some releases are a deliberate service call.
evidence: agent note states the pickup had not happened when the refund was issued

rationale: Policy S4 contact costs. The refund is a reversal, not a loss, so only the cost of the contact is counted. Reliable order creation removes most.
evidence: ai_theme=payment_failure; cost = policy S4 channel rate + Rs 305 per transfer
